purpose: Precommit the settlement choice and prove Bitcoin confirmation before Ethereum settlement without comparing cross-chain timestamps

bitcoinAnchorCommitment.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), UTF-8 bytes
bitcoinAnchorCommitment.broadcastRule: Both parties byte-compare the complete Bitcoin anchor preimage before broadcast
bitcoinAnchorCommitment.confirmationRule: The anchor transaction must have at least one Bitcoin confirmation

ethereumOrderingCommitment.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), UTF-8 bytes
ethereumOrderingCommitment.broadcastRule: After the Bitcoin confirmation is known, both parties byte-compare the complete Ethereum ordering preimage and orderingCommitmentHash before broadcast
ethereumOrderingCommitment.orderingProof: The preimage binds the unpredictable Bitcoin confirming block hash; Ethereum inclusion at block E therefore follows that Bitcoin block, and candidate blockNumber > E proves settlement follows both commitments without a cross-chain clock

candidateWindow.opensOnlyAfter: The Ethereum ordering commitment transaction succeeds in block E
candidateWindow.sameChainOrderPredicate: Ethereum candidate blockNumber must be strictly greater than E
candidateWindow.closesAt: The signed pre-trade gate validUntil; never widen the registered 600-second window
candidateWindow.expiryCheck: candidate block.timestamp must be less than or equal to the signed gate validUntil; this checks gate validity only and is not used to order Bitcoin against Ethereum

selection: Select and attest the first event satisfying every venue, direction, minimum-source-leg, candidate-window and canonical-order predicate

abortAndRetry.ethereumReorgCheck: Immediately before final-package publication, fetch block E by number and require its canonical block hash to equal ethereumCommitmentBlockHash; if the block is absent or the hash differs, abort the attempt and publish it as an abort with every Bitcoin anchor and Ethereum commitment transaction id
abortAndRetry.postPublicationRecheck: A later rechecker compares block E's canonical hash to the published ethereumCommitmentBlockHash; any mismatch is reported as REORG_DETECTED and the published record is never silently rewritten

finalPackageMustPublish: complete v2 selection-rule object and selectionRuleHash
Bitcoin anchor preimage, txid, confirming block height and confirming block hash
Ethereum ordering preimage, orderingCommitmentHash, transaction hash, ethereumCommitmentBlockNumber E and ethereumCommitmentBlockHash
selected receipt or explicit abort reason
every Bitcoin anchor and Ethereum commitment txid from aborted attempts

proofScope.ethereumOrderingCommitment: short-horizon public ordering: Bitcoin confirmation and gate/rule commitment precede settlement
proofScope.bitcoinAnchor: durable censorship-resistant evidence that the committed record existed
notClaimed: VERITAS proves the Insight verdict correct
an anchor makes an expired gate fresh
